Boson Identity keeps your Boson identity on this phone, under your control, and uses it to look after your account, devices and nodes.
Learn more about the Boson network
Your identity\'s key will be sealed for your new phone

On the new phone, install Boson Identity and choose \"I already have one\", then \"Move from my old phone\". This phone then shows a code, and a QR code for the new phone to scan. Your identity, its home node and its profile move; no node is needed for the move itself.
This identity has no home node: its avatar stays on this phone. You can set it again on the new phone.
The next screens hold your identity. Make sure no one else can see this screen, and don\'t photograph it. Screenshots are blocked.
You\'ll type it on the new phone after scanning. Only this code opens what the QR code holds.
Keep it to yourself. It is only good for this move.
Scan this with the new phone
On the new phone, scan this code, then type the code you noted.
Once your identity works on the new phone, you can remove it from this one. Or keep it on both phones.
